summary: Frontend-only verification of new Day Report screen + PDF export. All acceptance criteria pass. Tapping dashboard-hero-press navigates to /day-report/<date> and renders day-report-screen with correct summary grid (Total Sales ₹400, Quantity 8 kg, Bills 1, Customers 1, Received ₹100, Pending ₹300) and one 'Meena' bill card with 'Partial' badge showing Total ₹400 / Received ₹100 / Pending ₹300. Changing day-report-date to Yesterday updates the list to 'No sales on this day'. Tapping day-report-export-pdf triggers window.print (expo-print printAsync path); the app remains usable with no uncaught JS errors. Only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) observed.
critical_code_review_comments: pdf.ts catches errors silently via toast — good; consider re-throwing on web when user cancels print, but not blocking.
day-report/[date].tsx statusOf uses 0.0001 tolerance consistently; buildHtml() is a large inline template — acceptable but could be extracted to a helper for testability.
seed_data_creation: Created a single sale (Meena, 8kg × ₹50, received ₹100) via UI for regression. Data persisted only within the Playwright browser context (AsyncStorage/IndexedDB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day Report feature is fully working. Hero click -> /day-report/<selectedDate>. testIDs: day-report-screen, day-report-date, day-report-sale-<id>, day-report-export-pdf. For PDF export testing on web, intercept window.print BEFORE clicking export to avoid blocking the headless browser (page.evaluate('window.print=()=>{...}')). RN-Web Buttons render as divs — use page.get_by_text('Yesterday'/'Today', exact=True) to select calendar buttons inside DateField modal.
